venue: Flamingo Showroom at Flamingo Las Vegas

zones.label: Orange seating
zones.description: Orange is the seating nearest the stage, split above and below the center walkway on the chart. Choose it when being closer matters most.

zones.label: Pink seating
zones.description: Pink sits just behind orange, in the closer half of the middle seating. It is one of our two picks for a strong middle position facing the stage.

zones.label: Purple seating
zones.description: Purple is the next middle band behind pink, before the cyan seating. It is our other pick if you want a little more distance while staying in the main seating area.

zones.label: Cyan seating
zones.description: Cyan is the back band of the main seating on either side of the MIX area. Choose it for more distance from the stage.

zones.label: Balcony
zones.description: The balcony is the separate area to the right of the main seating on the chart. Choose it for a more distant perspective over the room.
